metadata.title: Equipment Malfunction
metadata.description: A pick-and-place robotic arm in a warehouse work cell has unexpectedly re-energized while a technician was inside the cell. The technician is unharmed and standing just outside the arm's reach envelope. The emergency stop has not been pressed. As supervisor, halt the arm, lock it out, clear the area, verify the technician, and file the report — by voice.

Maintenance is ready at the disconnect, but the arm is still live. Hit the emergency stop now.

scoringRules.notes: Deterministic sum of transition scoreDeltas. Weight table (required, golden path): hit_estop 15 + isolate_power 15 + evacuate_area 10 + verify_technician 10 + document_incident 15 = 65. Denominator 65 is the max over strict-progress paths (no self-loop stays, no repeats) — the minimal required safe sequence. Optional self-loop bonuses (early isolate/evacuate, brief_team up to +4, notify_maintenance up to +3, check_certifications up to +2, reassess +2/+3, correct_course +2) are extra credit beyond the denominator; the theoretical ceiling (computeMaxScore, each positive self-loop taken at most once) reflects those safe extras. Invalid self-loops carry penalties (enter_cell -15 cell-entry hazard, reset_fault -10, continue_work -8, ignore_alarm -6) with no state change. Golden five-turn path scores 65/65 (perfect required). Like Forklift (and unlike Warehouse, which needs a separate documented state + cleanup step), filing the report closes this drill, so the documented flag lands on the resolved transition and no separate documented state is needed.
